facts.text: Opey the walrus at the aquarium
facts.why: The walrus is Jocko, and Henry works at Sea Life Park Hawaii, not an aquarium. The menu's own dish note already says Jocko.
facts.fix: Jocko the walrus at Sea Life Park

facts.text: The painting of the day before
facts.why: Lucy paints, and the plot ends with her showing Henry dozens of portraits she has painted of him. Nothing about a painting of the day before.

vibe.verdict: The waffle house cue and the morning tape are the right hits and the Hawaii food fits, but the tiki 'evening' theme is off for a breakfast film.
missing: Ten Second Tom ('Hi, I'm Tom', the café)
Henry's pet penguin Willy (Sea Life Park)
'Wouldn't It Be Nice' on the Beach Boys CD (Marlin's gift)
Marlin and Doug re-enacting Marlin's birthday every day
Henry and Lucy on the boat at the end watching the glaciers
ideas: Swap 'Huli huli pineapple soy chicken' note for Marlin's birthday pineapple and the cow crash
Replace 'Lomi lomi salmon' note with Ten Second Tom's 'Hi, I'm Tom' gag
Swap 'Islands of the evening' for 'Islands of the morning' to match the breakfast cue
Replace 'Hawaiian poke cups' with a Willy the penguin fish bowl
